propositions: An optional isolated adapter must mine Claude Code session transcripts via error-signature grep (patterns: LLMUnavailableError, ConnectionError, ModuleNotFoundError, etc.) and classify matches using deterministic keyword/regex rules into five categories (env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none), emitting JSON records labeled source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified.

The adapter and backfill script must be quarantined from the core metrics command — core modules (registry.py, __init__.py) must not import adapters.claude_transcripts, verified by static import scan.

Classification must be deterministic (no LLM/network calls) and match a normative pattern→enum routing table where first match wins, with all non-matching candidate lines classified as none and dropped from output.
Emitted records must follow JSON schema with fields: kind (classification enum value), signature (matched pattern), ts (ISO-8601 timestamp), source (backfill_classified), confidence (classified).

Unit tests must verify: fixture JSONL with known error signature is extracted and classified with correct labels; clean transcript yields zero records; core modules do not import the adapter; backfill script entry point exercises the full pipeline over a fixture transcript directory.
